description:
The issue appears to be affecting gLinux rodete dev environment (g++ 15.2.0 and binutils 2.45) but not our CI (ubuntu2204, g++11.4.0 and binutils 2.38). Bazel team suggested this temporary fix.

Based on some testing it seems like g++ 15 is passing -Wa,--gsframe=yes by default, the corresponding assembler flag is introduced somewhere between binutils 2.38 and 2.45. Hence we need a version check in the gen_upb_api_from_bazel.sh script.

This is just a monkey patch with caveats though. This script is now gcc only and can break if you have clang installed locally (which is why I put the options in a separate `bazelrc` file, and explicitly set CC/CXX flags to build upb sources).

comments.body:
I suggest moving this file into the artifact_gen subdirectory, since it's not needed outside of there.

Once you do that, then I think this PR won't require any import CL.

Note: this compares strings in lexicographical order, so it's prone to errors like so:

```console
bash-5.3$ [[ "15.0.2" > "15.0.12" ]] && echo 1
1
```

In this case it's more-or-less OK since we're only have single digits in minor and patch places.
You probably wanted to include `15.0.0` in this range too.
